item.title: Data-centric AI for Social Science
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of Information Processing & Management focuses on data-centric approaches to artificial intelligence within social science research. The collection seeks contributions that explore how AI methodologies can be applied to social science problems with emphasis on data quality, management, and curation practices.
